items.original_context: Additive category theory: finite biproduct or direct sum of objects, simultaneously product and coproduct with compatible injection and projection maps.
items.preliminary_definition: A finite biproduct of objects M_1,…,M_n in an additive category is an object M with maps i_j:M_j→M and p_j:M→M_j satisfying p_j i_k=δ_{jk} id_{M_j} and Σ_j i_j p_j=id_M.
